parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Give the formulas of the conjugate acid and the conjugate base of the hydrogen phosphate ion, $\text{HPO}_4^{2-}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The $K_\text{a}$ of propanoic acid, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{COOH}$, is $1.35 \times 10^{-5} \text{mol dm}^{-3}$ at $298 \text{K}$.

Solution $\mathbf{C}$ is a solution of $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{COOH}$ with a pH of 3.60 at $298 \text{K}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Calculate the concentration of $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{COOH}$ in solution $\mathbf{C}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the concentration of hydroxide ions in solution $\mathbf{C}$.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Calculate the concentration of a solution of hydrochloric acid with the same pH as solution $\mathbf{C}$.

parts.label: (b)(iv)

Place a tick in Table 3.1 to show the correct value. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Solution $\mathbf{D}$ is made by mixing $100 \text{cm}^3$ of $0.100 \text{mol dm}^{-3}$ $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{COOH}$ and $100 \text{cm}^3$ of $0.100 \text{mol dm}^{-3}$ $\text{NaCl}$.

The pH of solution $\mathbf{D}$ is measured as small amounts of $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4\text{(aq)}$ are added to it, and when small amounts of $\text{NaOH(aq)}$ are added to it.

Solution $\mathbf{D}$ only acts as a buffer solution when **one** of these solutions is added to it.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Complete the sentence and write an equation for the reaction that occurs.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Complete the sentence and explain why solution $\mathbf{D}$ does **not** act as a buffer when the other solution is added.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Manganese(II) hydroxide, $\text{Mn(OH)}_2$, is only slightly soluble in water.

The solubility of $\text{Mn(OH)}_2$ in water is $3.28 \times 10^{-3} \text{g dm}^{-3}$ at $298 \text{K}$.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text: Calculate the concentration of a saturated solution of $\text{Mn(OH)}_2$ at $298 \text{K}$.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Write an expression for the $K_\text{sp}$ of $\text{Mn(OH)}_2$. Give the units of $K_\text{sp}$.

parts.label: (d)(iii)
parts.text: Use your answers to **(d)(i)** and **(d)(ii)** to calculate the value of $K_\text{sp}$ of $\text{Mn(OH)}_2$ at $298 \text{K}$.
